pl: Witaj, {name}. Kruki doniosły, że idziesz. Nikt się nie ucieszył.
{name} w bramie. Chowajcie miód.

{name}, greydwarfy już ustawiają się w kolejce.

en: Welcome, {name}. The ravens told us. Nobody cheered.
{name} at the gate. Hide the mead.
Odin watches with one eye, {name}. He lost the other looking at your building.
Mead in the horn, {name}. It won't drink itself. Someone tried.
The doors of Valhalla are heavy, {name}. So is your inventory.
The wind turns in your favour, {name}. First time in recorded history.
Welcome, {name}. The forest remembers your axe and is still afraid.
The sea knows your name, {name}, and still hasn't drowned you. Odd.
Yggdrasil trembles. Either the world ends or {name} is building again.
The fire burns higher. {name} has arrived.
{name}, the greydwarves are already forming a queue.
Welcome to VintageSrv, {name}. Leave the mud outside, you animal.
Your longship waits, {name}. More patiently than we do.
The Norns are spinning your name today, {name}. Short thread.
Dawn belongs to you, {name}. Night belongs to trolls. Don't mix them up.
The anvil is cooling, {name}. Unlike your terrible ideas.
Welcome, {name}. Runes don't carve themselves, and you can't read anyway.
{name} walks in. The swords in the rack shiver.
Thor rolls over, {name}. He sleeps lightly. You don't walk lightly.
Salt in the beard is a good sign, {name}. Or you haven't washed in a week.
The ground is hard, {name}, but your skull is harder.
Welcome, {name}. The rain stopped. Pure coincidence.
A wolf in the distance, {name}. Not your problem yet.
Mead, fire, roof — you have the full set, {name}. Don't ruin it.
The ravens fly your way today, {name}. They know where the corpses land.
The fjord opens before you, {name}. Without warning, as usual.
Welcome, {name}. The stones on the cairns are still warm.
Sail up, {name}. The rest sorts itself out. It usually doesn't.
Odin is writing down your arrival, {name}. Don't ask what with.
The pantry is empty, {name}. The world isn't. Go.
Welcome back, {name}. Nobody touched anything. Allegedly.
Your blade has gone blunt from waiting, {name}.
The fog parts, {name}. Very courteous of it.
{name} returns. The ravens fall silent out of respect. Or fear.
Welcome, {name}. The trolls are asleep. Keep it down, damn it.
The fire spits a spark, {name}. That's the whole welcome you're getting.
Wind at your back, {name}. Use it before it changes its mind.
There's still room in Valhalla, {name}. No need to hurry that much.
Welcome, {name}. The forest is merciful today. Until noon.
Your tracks are still in the snow, {name}. Shallow, for a warrior.
The gods are watching, {name}. They have no intention of helping.
Salt, wind and an axe, {name}. Nothing else needed. Except skill.
Welcome, {name}. Anchor down, tankard up.
Wood does not chop itself, {name}. Tested repeatedly.
The world waits, {name}. The world is more patient than we are.
A raven lands on the roof beam, {name}. A good omen, or a leak.
Welcome, {name}. The chimney smoke leads home. Yours, not somebody else's.
The sea is calm today, {name}. Do not trust it for a second.
Fire, mead, a name — {name} is here, the set is complete.
The runes say it's good you're here, {name}. The runes lie.
Welcome, {name}. Take a cloak, the wind is a bastard.
Yesterday a storm, today you, {name}. Hard to say which is worse.
Odin nods, {name}. That is the entire extent of his help.
The deck planks remember your weight, {name}. They complain about it.
Welcome, {name}. The beasts in the woods are awake. Your fault.
The rock pile is waiting for a pick, {name}. The pick is waiting for you.
Wolves are howling, {name}. Not about you. For now.
The fire is lit, {name}. Not by you, but sit down anyway.
Welcome, {name}. The mead is ripening just in time for your mistakes.
Your hammer leaves a mark on the anvil, {name}. The smith weeps.
Waves against the hull, {name}. Familiar rhythm, less familiar stomach.
Dawn finds you ready for nothing in particular, {name}.
Welcome, {name}. The runestone says nothing. That counts as approval.
The wind carries smoke and resin, {name}. And your decisions.
Valhalla can wait, {name}. It has time. You don't.
Something is bubbling in the pot, {name}. Don't ask what.
Welcome, {name}. The snow creaks underfoot. Pretty and treacherous.
The trees are counting your axes, {name}. The number worries them.
Odin's ravens bring word, {name}: you exist. Nobody asked.
Iron does not climb out of the swamp on its own, {name}. Neither does the swamp.
Welcome, {name}. A good day not to die. Do try.
Shield on your back, fire in your belly, {name}. And mead in your head.
Land on the horizon, {name}. Yours, if you make it.
Fog over the meadow, {name}. And you inside it, lost as usual.
Welcome, {name}. The world has sharp teeth. You have an axe. Even match.
The fire hisses, {name}. That means sit and stop talking.
The gods are busy, {name}. Sort it out yourself.
A raven tilts its head, {name}. It recognises you. It is not thrilled.
Welcome, {name}. The tankard is waiting, but not forever.
The door creaks, {name}. That's you, not a ghost. Probably.
Welcome, {name}. The shadows are getting longer and you're standing still.
The whetstone is free, {name}. Your blade is begging for mercy.
Smoke straight up, {name}. Good weather coming. Or a fire.
A fresh scratch on the shield, {name}. That is what history looks like.
Welcome, {name}. Mead in the cellar, enemies in the woods. Simple choice.
Sharpen the axe, {name}, before the forest wakes up.
The ravens are in a good mood today, {name}. Somebody died.
The sea smells of adventure, {name}. And fish. Mostly fish.
Welcome, {name}. The wolves are fed, so there's peace for an hour.
Your house is still standing, {name}. Verified. Don't ask by whom.
The stars are still out, {name}. Move while it's dark.
Welcome, {name}. You should have come earlier. You always should have.
The world hasn't changed, {name}. It still wants you dead.
The runes fall well today, {name}. Even runes have off days.
Wind at your back, sun in your eyes, {name}. One of those is a problem.
Welcome, {name}. Tankard on the left, axe on the right. Don't mix them up.
The ground is frozen, {name}. Dig deeper or go home.
Odin doesn't say welcome. I do, {name}. Appreciate it.
The longhouse is empty, {name}. Fill it with noise.
Welcome, {name}. Rain puts out fire, not you. Unfortunately.
The raven vanishes into the fog, {name}. You stay. Somebody has to.
A wave lifts the longship, {name}. Time to move.
The sail flaps impatiently, {name}. More impatiently than we do.
Welcome, {name}. The coals in the forge are still alive.
Something good is ageing in that barrel, {name}. Hands off until evening.
Cold dawn, {name}. Warm mead. Priorities are clear.
Yggdrasil's roots run deep, {name}. Your foundations don't.
Welcome, {name}. Quiet before the voyage. Savour it.
A greydwarf glances at you and runs, {name}. Smarter than you.
Stone, wood, iron, {name}. Pick one and stop whining.
Your name sounds good by the fire, {name}. Less good in the ledger.
Welcome, {name}. The world is waiting for a loud noise. Make it.
Empty net, full sea, {name}. Draw your own conclusions.
The night is over, {name}. You're still standing. That's luck, not skill.
The chest is locked, {name}. You have the key. Probably.
Welcome, {name}. The wind brings salt and the promise of trouble.
Tracks in the mud lead home, {name}. Whether they're yours is another matter.
Fire, iron, stubbornness — {name} is back.
The forest is in a good mood today, {name}. Don't push it.
Welcome, {name}. Ravens circling high. Relax, not for you yet.
Heavy hammer, steady hand, {name}. So you claim.
The fjord glitters, {name}. Sail while you can see.
Nobody touches your chest, {name}. Because it's empty.
Welcome, {name}. Hard ground, harder will, hardest head.
That last beam is still waiting, {name}. Three days now.
The gods are silent, {name}. Best news of the day.
The chimney roars, {name}. The house is alive. So are you.
Welcome, {name}. Today you write the saga. A short one.
Oars ready, crew ready, {name}. Only sense is missing.
Snow is falling, {name}. The fire holds, as long as you don't.
Your axe knows these trees, {name}. The trees remember.
Welcome, {name}. Mead and quiet — a rare set. Go ruin it.
The sea takes and gives back, {name}. Today it gave back you. Reluctantly.
The raven calls three times, {name}. It means: welcome, damn you.
Dawn rises with you, {name}. One of you is late.
Welcome, {name}. Hot forge, simple plan, terrible execution.
Something moves on the horizon, {name}. Dinner, probably. Whose is unclear.
